info.name: SUST CSE Academic Management System
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Academic Management System with 60+ endpoints across 5 phases.

**Features:**
- Multi-role authentication (Admin, Teacher, Student)
- Advisor management
- Notice board with PDFs
- Feedback system
- Results with Excel upload
- Admissions & applications
- Society management
- Banner system

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection
2. Import the environment file
3. Set `baseUrl` to your server (default: http://localhost:5000)
4. Run authentication requests to get tokens
5. Tokens are auto-saved to environment variables
